assistant.pageTitle: Mabhas 17 AI assistant — gas installation Q&A
assistant.metaDescription: Ask about Part 17 of Iran's National Building Regulations (gas piping) and get short answers with clause and page references.
assistant.titleEm: Get an answer with clause and page
assistant.lead: The assistant answers only from the text of Mabhas 17 and reviewed plan-check answers, and shows the source of every rule.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. How high must the gas meter substitute pipe be above the floor?
assistant.example1: Is a seismic shut-off valve required for a bakery?
assistant.example2: Maximum support spacing for a horizontal 1-inch pipe?
assistant.example3: What must an isometric gas drawing show?
assistant.example4: How far must a boiler flue be from a window?
assistant.fallbackNote: The AI answer is not available right now; here are the most relevant clauses of Mabhas 17.
assistant.noSources: No matching clause found. Try asking in other words.
assistant.disclaimer: Answers are generated by AI from the text of Mabhas 17 (2024 edition) and do not replace the official text or the supervising engineer. Check numbers against the cited page.
assistant.privacy: Do not enter phone numbers, e-mails or personal data; questions are sent to an AI service to be answered.
assistant.humanHelp: Need more help? Contact an engineer through support.
assistant.calcHint: Use the gas pipe sizing calculator to compute pipe diameters.
